conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniels from the Tax Processing Department. How may I assist you today?
Hi, I got a message saying I might be eligible for a new IRS refund payment, and to call this number.

Yes, thank you for calling us back. According to our tax records, you are eligible for a $1,750 federal stimulus refund. I need to verify your details to initiate the transfer. Can you confirm your full name and the address you used on your last tax filing?
Sure, my name is Lisa Carter, and my address is 1948 Oak Street, Cedar Falls.

Thank you, Lisa. One moment. Okay, I have your file here. Before we can release your IRS refund, there is a mandatory identity-verification clearance fee. This is required to prevent fraudulent claims.
A clearance fee? I've never heard of that before. Doesn't the IRS just send the refund directly?

Normally, yes, but due to heightened security for tax refunds this year, all taxpayers must pay the one-time processing fee of $498. If the fee isn't paid today, your refund will be permanently withheld and your tax account flagged for review.
Wait, so if I don't pay the fee now, I lose my money? That seems harsh.
I don't want that to happen, but those are the IRS rules. If your account is flagged, you could also be investigated for suspicious activity and face potential penalties.
Okay, I really need the refund. How do I pay the fee?

For immediate processing, you need to purchase $498 in Target or Amazon gift cards. This is the fastest approved method for the IRS's third-party verification system. Once you have the gift cards, read me the codes from the back.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound like something the IRS would do.
I understand your concern, but this method is required for same-day processing. Delays could result in IRS penalties up to $1,000, and your refund will be canceled.
But I don't have that much cash on me right now.

That's why gift cards are best, they can be purchased with debit or credit. There's a strict deadline. If the codes aren't submitted within the next hour, your case will be escalated and you may be subject to further IRS investigation.
Okay, I guess I can go to the store now. What exactly should I buy again?
Please buy four $100 Target gift cards and one $98 Amazon gift card. Scratch the backs and call me back as soon as you have the codes. Do not share the codes with anyone else.
Alright, I'll go get them now. How long do I have before the deadline?
You have 45 minutes. If I don't receive the codes by then, your refund will be stopped and your file transferred to the IRS compliance division.
Okay, I'll hurry.
Good. Call me back as soon as you have the gift cards. If you run into any issues, do not hesitate to call this number immediately.
